item: The stream writes Q705 page facts with each version it stores
refs: Lane M finding and review; Q705; 0.6 row D
summary: WikiStreamAdapter.fetch_version now reads the Q705 facts (coordinates, Wikidata item, categories, protection, length, infobox, citation-needed count) from the SAME response it already asked for and returns them on FetchedVersion.facts; the substrate hands them back to the adapter's optional store_facts hook inside the version's savepoint, so the Living sources coordinates layer, which reads versioned_entity_facts, finally has rows. No new request; absent fields stay absent; a failed fact write rolls the version back; a lane without the hook stores nothing. A fact the page LOSES (a removed coordinate, an unlinked Wikidata item, its last category) is cleared when the id-addressed request asked for its prop and the answer lacked it; the title path and props not asked are never read as an answer.
